title: Ara Blanket Square – Free Crochet Pattern
author: Kristine (Ambassador Crochet)
notes: Circle, then a 6-point star of shells and sc-filled ch-7 arches, then squared with graded sc/hdc/dc, then skip-stitch 2-dc rounds. start: 'Make magic ring,' written as 'Make a magic ring.'. Heading 'Rounds 8 – 9:' normalised to 'Rounds 8-9:' and 'Rounds 10:' to 'Round 10:'. Joins written 'sl st in first sc' after dc rounds are kept as published.
